content.short: Multipli lets users borrow against tokenized real-world assets such as gold, stocks and Treasuries.
content.description: Multipli turns tokenized real-world assets into productive collateral, letting holders of tokenized gold, equities, index exposure and Treasuries borrow against them through its rwaUSD stablecoin rather than selling. It operates on Monad among other chains. Borrowing against assets rather than liquidating them is the ordinary use of a brokerage margin account, and it is one of the more practical reasons to hold those assets on-chain at all.
